contract: Initialization binding forces apply for selected enabled controls even without selected state style.
Public selected compares native checked, direct style selected has a separate gate and changed-event deduplication.
Base empty state does not qualify, adaptive empty state does qualify.
Ordered synchronous width3 then width0 retains width3 attribute.
Disabled blocks selected/down/focus/error but qualifying hover can apply disabled style.
Full style passed to SVG includes base defaults and resolved state overrides; partial lower-level paint probes do not define caller behavior.
boundaries: No original DLL or GUI execution.
No full generated project or complete initialization event environment.
No groups/contained parents/repeaters/master chains/image overrides/applied-style actions.
